title: Best Plush Toy (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were chosen from the cited sources that explicitly recommend them, prioritizing those mentioned by more than one source. The CNET review of Poe, the Taste of Home feature on Warmies, the Sassimals review, and the Hugz/Hugimals mentions were used.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.
